Class WordWrap

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.format.WordWrap
public final class WordWrap extends Object
The WordWrap type hard-wraps text at spaces. Structured renderers call it. The unmatched identity path does not call it. The type has no instances.

  • Method Details

    • wrap

      public static String wrap(String text, int width)
      The wrap method flows paragraphs and then hard-wraps each run. A null or empty text returns the empty string. ParagraphFlow.flow(String) keeps a blank line as a paragraph break and turns a single line feed into a space. If the flowed text is empty, the method returns the empty string. A width below 8 becomes 8. A carriage return is skipped. Each flowed line, including the end of the text, is passed to flushLine(StringBuilder, String, int). A line feed in the flowed text is written after that line. The result uses line feeds, not carriage returns. // @aa-sdd GK-0981 aetheris-plan-f-217.001.md FINESSE:f-217
      Parameters:
      text - The source text.
      width - The column width.
      Returns:
      The wrapped text, using line feeds.

    • flushLine

      private static void flushLine(StringBuilder out, String line, int width)
      The flushLine method wraps one flowed line at word boundaries. An empty line writes nothing. A space or tab is copied as one space only when the current column is already past zero and still under the width. If the next word does not fit on the current column, the method writes a line feed and starts at column zero. If the column is already past zero and the word fits, the method writes one space before the word. A word longer than the width, starting at column zero, is cut into pieces of that width and a line feed is written between pieces. A shorter word is written whole.
      Parameters:
      out - The destination.
      line - One flowed line.
      width - The column width.
